caption: Day 13 of 30 Family Dinners Toddlers Actually Eat 🤍 Ground Beef Stew Over Rice 🥣🍚 Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * 1 small onion * 2 cups peas & carrots * 2 garlic cloves * ½ cup tomato sauce * 2 cups water * ½ tsp paprika * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp oregano * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper * Fresh parsley * Cooked rice Directions Brown the ground beef in olive oil, then cook the onion until softened. Add the peas & carrots, garlic, tomato sauce, seasonings, and water.
